integrity: Infinite-dimensional proof uses connectedness of the unit sphere and multiplicative norm bounds, with no finite extrapolation or external certificate. Self-review completed; no independent audit performed.
limitations: Exactly Definition 3.3 of arXiv:2610.01196v1; no classification of other expansivity notions; lower growth radius is not generally the inner spectral modulus; literature coverage may be incomplete.
title: Exact scalar annulus for super-asymptotic expansivity on Banach spaces
